title: Context receipt event, spec v1
description: One event in the life of a context receipt. A receipt is a `retrieval` event followed by any number of `output`, `evidence` and `outcome` events that reference its receipt_id. Events carry identifiers, versions, hashes and scores only, never raw context, queries or output text.

source_asset_key.description: Dagster asset key the item was derived from, as a user string (e.g. 'support/tickets').

source_version.description: Should equal the source asset's dagster/data_version at retrieval time; this is how stale reads are detected.

selection.description: 'explore' marks items placed by reserved exploration traffic so analysis can discount them.

reason.description: Suggested: pii, stale, out_of_scope, over_budget, policy. Any non-empty string is valid.

receipt_id.description: Assigned by the writer (a ULID is recommended: time-sortable, no round trip). Re-sending an existing id is a no-op for consumers.

created_at.description: Informational. In v1 consumers stamp their own write time.

query_hash.description: One-way digest of the query, never the query.

excluded_count.description: Must be >= the number of excluded items listed.

items.description: item_ids must be unique within a receipt and disjoint from `excluded`.

output_hash.description: Hash of the output, never the output.

level.description: What was done, not how certain the outcome is. 'retrieved' is implicit in the retrieval event.

details.description: References and hashes only. `item_ids` (array of strings), if present, scopes this evidence to those retrieved items; otherwise it applies to all of them.

signal.description: Known: thumbs_up, thumbs_down, accepted, edited, escalated, reopened, closed_won, closed_lost. Others require `value`.

value.description: Quality in [-1, 1]. Defaults by signal for known signals.

outcome_ref.description: Identity of the judge (user id, ticket id). A later outcome with the same outcome_ref supersedes the earlier one when scoring.
